name: Rockfish (RCG complex)
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Divers/shore exempt from boat season/depth rules (§27.20(b)(1)(D)). Sub-limits: copper 1, verm/sunset 2, canary 2; bronzespotted/cowcod/quillback/yelloweye 0. 8 offshore Groundfish Exclusion Areas closed to all (§27.50). Boat season closed: only spear gear aboard (§28.90(b)). Fillets whole skin.

name: Vermilion/sunset rockfish
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep <50 fm, Oct-Dec >50 fm, Jan-Mar closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Regulated as one unit; sunset is near-identical to vermilion. Shelf rockfish (§1.91(a)(3)): boat Oct-Dec only seaward of 50 fm. Sub-limit applies regardless of where taken. ID: rough chin, mottled red; canary has smooth chin and clear lateral line.

name: Copper rockfish
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Nearshore rockfish (§1.91(a)(1)): boat closed Oct-Dec. Statewide 1-fish sub-limit. ID caution: quillback (0 limit) and brown rockfish look similar; copper has pale lateral-line stripe on rear 2/3 of body.

name: Canary rockfish
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep <50 fm, Oct-Dec >50 fm, Jan-Mar closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Retention allowed in 2026 with 2-fish sub-limit (booklet §28.55(b)(4)); Cornell CCR mirror lacks (b)(4). Shelf rockfish: boat Oct-Dec only >50 fm. ID: orange w/ 3 orange bands on head, smooth chin, gray/clear lateral line; do not confuse with yelloweye (0 limit).

name: Bocaccio
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep <50 fm, Oct-Dec >50 fm, Jan-Mar closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Shelf rockfish (§1.91(a)(3)); no species sub-limit in 2026, counts toward 10 RCG. Boat Oct-Dec only seaward of 50 fm. Juveniles common in SoCal kelp/structure.

name: Treefish
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Nearshore rockfish (§1.91(a)(1)): boat closed Oct-Dec and Jan-Mar. Counts toward 10 RCG. Common SoCal reef/kelp species.

name: Gopher rockfish
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Nearshore rockfish: boat closed Oct-Dec and Jan-Mar. Counts toward 10 RCG. ID: near-identical to black-and-yellow (gopher blotches pinkish/whitish, black-and-yellow yellowish); same limit so ID error is not a citation.

name: Black-and-yellow rockfish
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Nearshore rockfish: boat closed Oct-Dec and Jan-Mar. Counts toward 10 RCG. Shallow reef species, common at Channel Islands.

name: Kelp rockfish
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Nearshore rockfish: boat closed Oct-Dec and Jan-Mar. Counts toward 10 RCG. Most common rockfish in SoCal kelp beds; ID vs brown rockfish (both same limit).

name: Grass rockfish
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Nearshore rockfish: boat closed Oct-Dec and Jan-Mar. Counts toward 10 RCG. Very shallow (intertidal to 50 ft) reef species, prime shore-dive target.

name: Brown rockfish
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Nearshore rockfish: boat closed Oct-Dec and Jan-Mar. Counts toward 10 RCG. Common in harbors/bays. ID caution: copper (1 limit) and quillback (0 limit) look similar; brown has dark blotch on gill cover.

name: Olive rockfish
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Nearshore rockfish: boat closed Oct-Dec and Jan-Mar. Counts toward 10 RCG. ID: near-identical yellowtail rockfish is shelf group (boat Oct-Dec >50fm only); irrelevant for divers, same limit.

name: Blue/deacon rockfish
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Blue rockfish is nearshore (§1.91(a)(1)); deacon not named in §1.91, CDFW treats it with blue. Boat closed Oct-Dec and Jan-Mar. Counts toward 10 RCG. Schooling in kelp canopy at Channel Islands.

name: Cowcod
season: Closed
spear: PROHIBITED - no take at all
notes: Zero limit statewide; shall not be taken or possessed (§28.55(b)(1)). Diver season exemption does NOT apply to (b)(1) species. Large pink/orange rockfish; juveniles occur in shallow SoCal water. Release immediately.

name: Yelloweye rockfish
season: Closed
spear: PROHIBITED - no take at all
notes: Zero limit statewide; shall not be taken or possessed (§28.55(b)(1)). Diver exemption does NOT apply. Bright yellow eye, orange-red body; juveniles have 2 white stripes. Do not confuse with canary (2 limit) or vermilion.

name: Bronzespotted rockfish
season: Closed
spear: PROHIBITED - no take at all
notes: Zero limit statewide; shall not be taken or possessed (§28.55(b)(1)). Diver exemption does NOT apply. Deepwater SoCal species (usually >250 ft), unlikely at freedive depth.

name: Quillback rockfish
season: Closed
spear: PROHIBITED - no take at all
notes: Zero limit statewide; shall not be taken or possessed (§28.55(b)(1)). Diver exemption does NOT apply. Nearshore species, rare south of Pt Conception. ID: tall deeply-notched dorsal spines, brown w/ orange-yellow speckling; resembles brown/copper.

name: Lingcod
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun, Jul-Sep <50 fm, Oct-Dec >50 fm, Jan-Mar closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Not part of RCG 10. Boat: Jan-Mar closed; Oct-Dec open only seaward of 50 fm. Fillets min 14 in with entire skin attached (§27.65(b)(3)). Closed in Groundfish Exclusion Areas (§27.50). Descending device required aboard boats (§27.20(b)(2)).

name: Cabezon
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Counts toward 10 RCG. Grouped with nearshore for boat season: closed Oct-Dec and Jan-Mar. Fillets must have entire skin attached. Roe is toxic - do not eat eggs.

name: Greenling (kelp/rock)
season: Divers all year. Boat: Apr-Jun all depths, Jul-Sep <50 fm, else closed
spear: OK; divers exempt from season/depth closure
notes: Genus Hexagrammos regulated as one unit under §28.29; counts toward 10 RCG. Boat season follows nearshore: closed Oct-Dec and Jan-Mar. Fillets entire skin attached. Uncommon south of Pt Conception; kelp greenling at N Channel Islands.
